The **Utility** group of the node palette has 10 nodes: 6 run, 4 cannot run yet or are deprecated.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [ArgMax](../utility/argmax.md) | Can't run yet | ArgMax is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
| [Calculator](../utility/calculator.md) | Runs | Math expression calculator. |
| [Constant](../utility/constant.md) | Runs | Emit a fixed scalar value on every simulation tick. |
| [Identity](../utility/identity.md) | Runs | Pass an Arrow table through unchanged. |
| [JSONPath](../utility/jsonpath.md) | Runs | The value at a path in each row's JSON. |
| [Lambda](../utility/lambda.md) | Can't run yet | Blocked custom tensor function retained for saved-graph compatibility. |
| [Parameter](../utility/parameter.md) | Can't run yet | Blocked standalone trainable parameter retained for saved-graph compatibility. |
| [Regex Tester](../utility/regex-tester.md) | Runs | Regular expression tester. |
| [Top K](../utility/top-k.md) | Can't run yet | Top K is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
| [Unit Converter](../utility/unit-converter.md) | Runs | Unit conversion utility. |
